faq.question: Which institution is this?
faq.answer: This is Shrimathi Devkunvar Nanalal Bhatt Vaishnav College for Women in Chromepet, Chennai, founded in 1968 and affiliated to the University of Madras. Other Vaishnav colleges have separate identities and admissions.

faq.question: Who do these entries cover?
faq.answer: The verified route covers women applying through regular domestic college admission. Programme-specific subjects or qualifying degrees and selection rules apply. Overseas conditions are not verified here and are not declared universally prohibited.

faq.question: How do aided and self-financing offerings differ?
faq.answer: They are separate funding categories with programme and shift distinctions. The same degree title may have more than one offering. Select the exact route when applying and request its own charges and timetable.

faq.question: How long are the supported programmes?
faq.answer: Undergraduate programmes are three years and postgraduate programmes two years. The B.Com. Honours name is not treated as a four-year award. Confirm the selected programme’s current curriculum and assessment requirements.

faq.question: Which school subjects are required?
faq.answer: Requirements differ by programme. Computing routes specify Mathematics or their exact listed alternatives; commerce awards have named commerce and accountancy combinations. Aided science degrees have their own science-subject conditions. Use the exact offering requirements.

faq.question: What are the postgraduate entry conditions?
faq.answer: Each degree lists its own qualifying award. For example, Computer Science accepts B.Sc. Computer Science or BCA, Biostatistics accepts Statistics or Mathematics, and Social Work accepts undergraduate degrees across disciplines. University recognition checks apply.

faq.question: Which programmes have written examinations?
faq.answer: The current eligibility document marks Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, BBA Digital Marketing and Business Analytics, and B.Com. Fintech and Artificial Intelligence for college written examinations. Follow the exact selection notice.

faq.question: Which teaching language is recorded?
faq.answer: English is recorded for the supported programmes except M.A. Tamil, whose named institutional postgraduate record specifies Tamil. Current undergraduate English-medium scope and the dated named programme records are used carefully; confirm classroom arrangements before enrolment.

faq.question: When does first-year study begin?
faq.answer: The college published 20 July 2026 for first-year postgraduate commencement. This is a dated published schedule, not a promise of a future window. An unverified undergraduate teaching-start month is omitted; follow current admission and reporting notices.

faq.question: How are fees provided?

Obtain an itemised quote for the exact degree, funding category and shift. Hostel, meals and living expenses are separate; aided status alone is not treated as zero tuition.

faq.question: Which documents are required?

Specified school boards, other states and other universities may require University of Madras eligibility or migration documents. Follow the exact admission checklist.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation guaranteed?
